description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor' responsible for handling AJAX requests related to ingredients management in a cooking/recipe application. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, moving, deleting, and creating ingredients, as well as fetching articles and units, with access control via capabilities.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing ingredients via AJAX in the Coocook application.

methods.name: project_base
methods.description: Chained method to set up project context, verifying 'dish' or 'recipe' and fetching the corresponding project entity.

methods.name: get_all_ingredients
methods.description: Retrieves all ingredients for the current dish or recipe, formatted for the ingredients editor.

methods.name: update_ingredient
methods.description: Updates an existing ingredient's value, unit, and comment based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: prepend_ingredient
methods.description: Moves an ingredient to the beginning of its group, optionally associating it with a recipe or dish.

methods.name: append_ingredient
methods.description: Moves an ingredient to the end of its group, optionally associating it with a recipe or dish.

methods.name: move_ingredient
methods.description: Reorders an ingredient within its group, moving it up or down.

methods.name: all_articles
methods.description: Fetches all articles associated with the current project.

methods.name: all_units
methods.description: Fetches all units associated with the current project.

methods.name: add_ingredient
methods.description: Creates a new ingredient, possibly creating new article and unit entries if they do not exist, and associates it with the current dish or recipe.
